Subject: Evidence request: HSM firmware chain-of-custody and ephemeral key wipe proof (SIG/CAIQ)

Hi Soojin,

We are preparing our SIG/CAIQ follow-up and need to validate a few items from Redwood for our security review. Can you provide the following artifacts for CloudFence (requesting evidence for onboarding):

- Signed firmware manifest(s) for HSMs that handled tenant key wrapping (last 12 months)
- Chain-of-custody / signature verification for firmware updates (including vendor attestations)
- Operator shift logs showing who applied updates and associated approvals (redaction for personal identifiers is acceptable)
- Rotation logs for KEK/Tenant wrapping keys (sample CSV with timestamps and rotation reason)
- Ephemeral key wipe/zeroization proof for sealed session keys (description + audit artifacts)

Please indicate if any artifacts contain customer-identifiable data so we can confirm redaction expectations. Also, if you have a packaged evidence bundle or secure transfer link, send that and we will download via our secure intake process.

Thanks,
Anya Volkov
CloudFence — Security Intake
security@cloudfence.com

P.S. If a short call helps, we can book 30 minutes next week to walk through the artifacts.

Soojin — quick status update and a few clarifying points. I pulled the requested artifacts and staged them.

What I uploaded to the secure evidence bucket (internal S3, access-controlled):
- s3://evidence-prod/soojin/cloudfence/2026-11/hsm_firmware_manifest.pdf (signed hashes + vendor attestations)
- s3://evidence-prod/soojin/cloudfence/2026-11/rotation_log_export.csv (redacted, sample rows below)
- s3://evidence-prod/soojin/cloudfence/2026-11/hsm_operator_shiftlog.txt (redacted)
- s3://evidence-prod/soojin/cloudfence/2026-11/wipe_certificate_sample.pdf (redacted)

Sample excerpt from rotation_log_export.csv (already redacted for tenant IDs):
"timestamp_utc,rotation_id,affected_key_type,rotation_reason,initiator_role"
"2026-02-03T14:22:10Z,rot-20260203-01,kek,scheduled-rotation,platform-ops"
"2026-05-10T03:11:45Z,rot-20260510-02,tenant-wrap,incident-eviction,security-ops"
"2026-09-14T21:05:02Z,rot-20260914-01,kek,scheduled-rotation,platform-ops"

Notes and clarifications:
- The firmware manifest includes vendor-signed SHA256 hashes and a PKCS7 signature file. We can include verification steps in the README to allow CloudFence to verify signatures locally.
- Operator logs contain shift IDs and approver role but we removed personal emails and replaced operator names with role tags per our redaction policy. If CloudFence requires full operator identities under an NDA, we can handle that via an escalation.
- Ephemeral wipe proof: we have a wipe certificate generated by the HSM vendor for one canonical session key; it asserts zeroization executed at the indicated timestamp and includes signature from the operator-approved attestation process.

I also uploaded an encrypted evidence bundle and placed a short README inside describing verification steps:
- s3://evidence-prod/soojin/cloudfence/2026-11/evidence_bundle_encrypted.zip (AES-256 encrypted; separate transfer of passphrase planned)

If you want, I can generate a CSV that maps rotation_id -> canonical hash to make spot verification easier for the reviewer.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
